data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean 2D game FX sprite sheet, exactly 2 rows by 2 columns, four animation frames arranged evenly on a solid #FF00FF background. No borders, no labels, no guide lines, no safe-area marks, no UI. Each frame centered in its cell and contained within the central 65% of the cell, with consistent scale and nothing crossing cell edges. Theme: ocean fantasy special-card trigger effect, elegant and readable at small card size, NOT an explosion.

Frame 1 (top-left): a small aqua pearl glow at the center, soft and subtle.
Frame 2 (top-right): thin sea-anemone petal rays open evenly from the center, cyan and seafoam tones, delicate and organic.
Frame 3 (bottom-left): a full circular chrysanthemum of flowing underwater light tendrils, soft radial sea-anemone petals, tiny bubbles and pearl glints, luminous but graceful.
Frame 4 (bottom-right): the rays fade into soft drifting bubbles and a faint aqua halo, gentle trailing glow.

Look like a sea anemone chrysanthemum made of soft radial light tendrils, not fire, not smoke, not fragments, not tearing. Effect only. High-quality game VFX sprite sheet, crisp and polished, oceanic glow, aqua/cyan/seafoam/pearl highlights.
